text.p: Quarter-final results in the European basketball championship on Friday:
Greece 72 Poland 62 (halftime 38-39)
Leading scorers:
Greece: Evangelios Koronios 18, Efthimis Rentzias 16,
Demetrios Papanikolaou 13, Nicolas Ekonomou 11, Fragiskos Alvertis 6.
Poland: Dominik Tomczyk 16, Maciej Zielinski 10, Adam Wojcik 8, Piotr Szybilski 8, Tomasz Jankowski 6.
Greece to play winner of Lithuania and Yugoslavia in the semi final.
Play-offs for ninth to 12th places:
France 84 Croatia 79 (halftime 40-37)

Croatia: Slaven Rimac 19, Damir Mulaomerovic 16, Niksa Prkacin 15, Davor Marcelic 15, Gordan Giricek 4, Sinisa Kelecevic 4, Ivan Grgat 4.
